leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function to calculate the total sum of a given array of integers
Construct a dynamic programming table to track subset sum possibilities
Manipulate boolean values in a DP array to mark achievable sums
Initialize a DP solution with base cases for the subset sum problem
Apply the subset sum algorithm to determine if equal partition is possible
Integrate early return conditions when the total sum is odd
Control iteration through array elements and possible sums in the DP approach
